column1: Marlowe last wishes — Cirren's handwritten record
column3: D225-MARLOWE-SPEAK-WITH-DEAD-Q5-BURIAL-001 · Day225 late afternoon, House Rethwyn rural lower wine cellar. First-person message transcription in Cirren's personal field journal, no new treasure/fee/gear award.
column4:
To Lady Elara Rethwyn: "Thank you for trusting me with your home. I tried to keep your people safe. I am sorry I left the work unfinished. The tenants need her more than the fields do."
To Sela Durn: "You were always capable of more than I let you believe. Trust your judgment. And don't carry every burden alone, as I did."
To Anwen Marlowe, his sister, last known in Caereth: "I should have come to supper more often. I always thought there would be another evening. I loved you, and I was proud to be your brother."
Final Q5: Marlowe requested burial in the village burial ground north of Rethwyn rural manor, among the people who worked the lands, NOT in Rethwyn family vault. He asked for a prayer to Tyr, a simple grave marker with his name, invitation to Anwen and Sela (Elara welcome but not obliged), NO grand procession/fine stone, and bread shared with tenants rather than gold lavished on the dead. Exact words in SESSION_LOG D225-MARLOWE-SPEAK-WITH-DEAD-Q5-BURIAL-001. These are wishes, not performed arrangements.
All four Speak with Dead question responses preserved in SESSION_LOG. Q5 uses final fifth question; no separate spellcasting. Note is PERSONAL CUSTODY of Cirren, not signed certification of Marlowe's active soul, and has NOT yet been delivered to recipients.
D225-RETHWYN-CLEANUP-SELA-VERIFIED-001: At rural manor after cleanup, Cirren personally read and delivered Sela Durn's exact Q4 message and Iven's Q5 village/Tyr/simple burial wishes. Sela received it and agreed to help organize arrangements; no grave or sister notification completed. Sela independently wrote/signed a caretaker summary of the safely cleared five-predator web route and added it to Cirren's existing field journal for Lady Elara. No new physical book item or fee.
D227-ELARA-RETHWYN-REPORT-001: At Lady Elara's Caereth CITY home on Day227 late afternoon, Cirren displayed the journal and Sela's signed account and read/delivered Elara's exact Q4 message; she personally heard it and responded with grief, promising appropriate modest burial and efforts to find sister Anwen. The Q4 message to Anwen Marlowe remains UNDELIVERED, Anwen's whereabouts/living status not verified. Q5 burial pending. The journal is still personally in Cirren's custody, quantity1. Older line 'not yet delivered to recipients' is HISTORICAL and superseded for Sela/Elara only.
